workflow.title: How Stallio works in action
workflow.subtitle: Explore how your social business transitions into a real online store.

create.title: Create your store in 60 seconds
create.body: Pick your shop name, upload your logo, and choose your primary accent brand color. Stallio instantly generates your storefront, instant checkout, and order inbox.
bullets: Instant live URL, no domain configuration needed

products.title: Add your products & variants
products.body: Photos, prices, variants, and stock counts in seconds. Add products directly from your camera roll and instantly get shareable product buy buttons.
bullets: Bulk photo uploads from mobile camera roll
Built-in variants, size options & live stock tracking

share.title: Share one link & receive orders
share.body: Copy your unique Stallio link into your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status, or TikTok profile. Customers browse and order without any DM back-and-forth.

lifecycle.title: Then orders manage themselves
lifecycle.subtitle: Every order moves through four structured stages so seller and buyer stay fully updated.

placed.label: Order Placed
placed.detail: Customer checks out directly from your shared link

confirmed.label: Order Confirmed
confirmed.detail: Automated order confirmation sent to customer

packed.label: Packed & Dispatched
packed.detail: Seller marks ready; delivery rider notified

domain.question: Do I need a website or custom domain?
domain.answer: No. Every Stallio store gets a live hosted link (stallio.shop/yourname) instantly. If you own a custom domain, you can connect it anytime.

whatsapp.question: Can customers order via WhatsApp?
whatsapp.answer: Yes. Stallio supports direct WhatsApp checkout handoff so customer details and cart items arrive structured in chat without tedious back-and-forth.

free.question: Is there a free plan to get started?
free.answer: Yes! You can create your store, upload products, and share your link for free with no credit card required.

payments.question: How do payments reach my account?
payments.answer: Stallio supports Cash on Delivery (COD) as well as online payments. Orders and payment status are tracked in your live dashboard.
